title.narrative: Climate Justice ClimAct Event OiE in HU

description.narrative: Youth mobilization for climate justice is one of the key themes of the Oxfam in Europe (OiE) initiative. Oxfam Novib is one of the principal contributors to OiE and currently hosts the program management for Spark ClimAct, a youth engagement climate justice program in Europe delivered by a consortium of 20 partners, of which seven are Oxfam affiliates. Part of the program is also delivered through Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTPs) – mainly youth organizations - and managed by CAN-Europe. Spark ClimAct will conclude in July 2024, and to date has mobilized over 2.1 million people, trained over 54,000 and raised awareness of climate justice to over 47 million. A program evaluation and learning trajectory is currently under way and is broadly focused on: Targeting of audiences; Governance, structure and organization of a consortium; Communicating intersecting issues to young people; Working with Activists; and Working with Movements. This trajectory will help identify knowledge and learnings to strengthen Oxfam in Europe strategy development and future proposals ahead of the next EC DEAR call in 2025. It is expected that the next EC DEAR call will have a strong focus on structured youth involvement in decision making and on facilitating access to financing via sub-grants and other means. In June there will be a Spark ClimAct consortium assembly to discuss, review and ratify the findings of the evaluation and learning trajectory (amongst other things). Given the relevance for OiE Climate Justice it is proposed to host an OiE meeting following from the assembly to build on common synergies and capitalize on a quorum of Oxfam representatives already in one location. This will complement strategy work underway in the dedicated OiE working group. A joint working session is planned between the Spark ClimAct partners and the Oxfam in Europe representatives on ways to improve the involvement of youth organizations in consortium-led programs. This session will take place as part of the ClimAct agenda and aims to include representatives of the OiE Climate justice Youth Reference and other youth climate organizations.

participating-org.narrative:
The overall objective of the National Society of Conservationists (NSC) is to protect nature as a whole and promote sustainable development. It has 113 member associations with almost 33,000 members across Hungary.
A large number of the member groups are small, local organisations whose main activities include environmental education, awareness raising, participation in uncovering and solving local environmental problems, environmental advisory work and nature conservation tasks. Regional organisations work on all known environmental and nature protection topics. The NSC is operated by a Board of 9 members who represent the member groups and there are 13 staff working in the Head Office.
Friends of the Earth Hungary is one of the 23 member groupsthat are involved in the School of Sustainability project.
